details.title: Mistral 7B
judge_issues: Loss functions and datasets are not mentioned, but it's likely that they are not a key part of the paper's contribution, so this is a minor omission.
details.judge_reasoning: The extraction is mostly accurate, but it misses the key components that must be included, which are Sliding Window Attention and Grouped-Query Attention. The rest of the information is present and correct.

extracted.title: Mistral 7B: A 7-Billion-Parameter Language Model for Superior Performance and Efficiency
extracted.problem: The problem of balancing high-performance language models with efficient inference and deployment
extracted.approach: Introducing Mistral 7B, a 7-billion-parameter language model that leverages grouped-query attention (GQA) and sliding window attention (SWA) to achieve superior performance and efficiency
extracted.key_results: Mistral 7B outperforms the best open 13B model (Llama 2) across all evaluated benchmarks, and the best released 34B model (Llama 1) in reasoning, mathematics, and code generation
extracted.novelty: The combination of GQA and SWA attention mechanisms, along with the rolling buffer cache and pre-fill and chunking techniques, allows for faster inference and reduced memory usage while maintaining high performance

extracted.title: Attention Is All You Need
extracted.problem: Improving the efficiency and parallelization of sequence transduction models
extracted.approach: Proposing a new model architecture, the Transformer, that relies entirely on attention mechanisms
extracted.key_results: 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German, 41.8 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-French
extracted.novelty: The first transduction model relying entirely on self-attention to compute representations of its input and output

details.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words (ViT)
judge_issues: The key_components_must_include field is missing 'patch embedding' and 'multi-head attention' which are crucial components of the Transformer architecture.
The key_results field is a string, it should be a list or a more structured format.
details.judge_reasoning: The extraction is mostly correct but lacks some crucial details and has minor formatting issues.

extracted.title: AN IMAGE IS WORTH 16X16 WORDS: TRANSFORMERS FOR IMAGE RECOGNITION AT SCALE
extracted.problem: The paper solves the problem of applying Transformer architecture to image recognition tasks, which has been limited by the need for convolutional neural networks (CNNs).
extracted.approach: The authors apply a standard Transformer directly to images, splitting them into patches and providing the sequence of linear embeddings of these patches as an input to a Transformer.
extracted.key_results: 88.55% accuracy on ImageNet, 90.72% on ImageNet-ReaL, 94.55% on CIFAR-100, and 77.63% on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
extracted.novelty: The paper demonstrates that large scale pre-training makes vanilla Transformers competitive with (or even better than) state-of-the-art CNNs.
